Our 40 foot sailing catamaran, the Kahala Kai, was built right here in Hawaii to safely navigate the waters around Waikiki. TOUR HIGHLIGHTS Flawless safety record since 1985. Guaranteed to see Hawaiian Sea Turtles and assorted tropical fish. May also see Dolphins, Whales (seasonal), Hawaiian Monk Seals, Octopus, and Flying Fish.
